approved-remote-administration-tool.title: Approved remote administration tool review
approved-remote-administration-tool.objective: Distinguish approved remote administration from unauthorized deployment or use.
approved-remote-administration-tool.selection_guidance: Use when the site's approved remote administration product, service, process, or network indicators are observed.

artifacts.notes: Replace placeholders with site-approved values outside this repository.
Compare observed deployment with the site's approved baseline.

expected_signals: Product, service, path, signer, account, and host scope match site policy.
benign_explanations: Approved support, management, or deployment activity.
caveats: Approved tooling can still be abused by an attacker.
A matching product name alone is not sufficient for disposition.
scope_expansion_triggers: Tooling appears outside approved hosts, paths, accounts, versions, hashes, or time windows.
